mapper.select: SELECT v.indicator_id AS indicatorId, i.name AS indicatorName, i.unit AS unit, r.exam_date AS examDate, v.is_abnormal AS isAbnormal FROM exam_value v JOIN exam_record r ON r.id = v.record_id JOIN exam_indicator i ON i.id = v.indicator_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND v.value_decimal IS NOT NULL AND i.status = 1 AND (i.owner_id = 0 OR i.owner_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY v.indicator_id, r.exam_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follow_up (user_id, indicator_id, last_exam_date, interval_days, due_date, priority, reason, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{indicatorId}, #{lastExamDate}, #{intervalDays}, #{dueDate}, #{priority}, #{reason}, 'pending') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE interval_days = VALUES(interval_days), priority = VALUES(priority), reason = VALUES(reason)
mapper.update: UPDATE follow_up SET status = 'done' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND indicator_id = #{indicatorId} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.indicator_id AS indicatorId, i.name AS indicatorName, i.unit AS unit, f.last_exam_date AS lastExamDate, f.interval_days AS intervalDays, f.due_date AS dueDate, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), f.due_date) AS overdueDays, f.priority, f.reason, f.note, f.status FROM follow_up f JOIN exam_indicator i ON i.id = f.indicator_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'pending' ORDER BY f.priority DESC, f.due_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE follow_up SET note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id}
